messages.author: df51706fbb6ed566
messages.subject: disconnected from shinyapps.io server
parts:
Hi,

I am testing some R Shiny apps using the free space on the R Studio shinyapps.io server. 

I have had success posting a few apps there in the past. 

Today I have posted a couple of new ones. The apps work properly when I test them locally. In contrast, if I publish them to shinyapps.io and try to open them I can see the dashboard I have designed for about 2-3 seconds. Then I get an error message "disconnected from server (reload)". If I "reload", the same thing happens again and again. 

I cannot tell what is failing or how to correct it! The older apps that I published a couple of months ago still work properly.

Any ideas?  

~dc

messages.author: df51706fbb6ed566
messages.subject: Re: disconnected from shinyapps.io server
parts: Ha! Just discovered how to view session logs. Problem solved.
